response.original_title: 【Book™~Guide】How Do I Book an Additional Room for My Freedom of the Sea Cruise?
response.overview: To add an additional stateroom or room to 1-866-259-1002 an existing Freedom of the Sea Cruise reservation, you must book the new room as a separate reservation and call Freedom of the Sea Cruises Customer Support at 1-866-259-1002 (or contact your travel agent) to link the booking numbers. To add an entirely separate room to an existing Freedom of the Sea Cruise +1-866-259-1002 (USA) or ☎ (UK) reservation, you cannot do it online; you must call Freedom of the Sea Cruise directly at ☎ +1-866-259-1002 (USA) or ☎ (UK) or contact your travel agent. To add a second room to an existing Freedom of the Sea Cruises 1- 866-259-1002 or reservation, you must call Freedom of the Sea Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1-866-259-1002 or, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a room to Freedom of the Sea Cruises online 1-866-259-1002
